course_name_original: The Agricultural and Food Industrial Electric Power Equipment Maintenance
course_name_en: The Agricultural and Food Industrial Electric Power Equipment Maintenance

learning_outcomes.text: The students to learn how to organize and carry out the activities of the agricultural and food industrial electric power equipment maintenance.
The students be able to decide practical issues.

syllabus_topics: The organization of the agricultural and food industrial electric power equipment maintenance
The food industrial electrical equipment maintenance
The maintenance of the electric apparatus for the protection and control processes of the electric power equipment
The electric power machines and transformers maintenance
assessment_rules: The exam includes a written part on two topics from the study material, which is followed by oral discussion and forming of the final mark.
